content.comment_body: Issue: When I change the IP address and reboot (power OFF/ON) my [product_name], the IP reverts to its original setting. How can I make the IP address change stay?

If you update the IP address of the [product_name], it should remain saved, even after restarting. The only situation I'm aware of where this doesn't happen is when an mSD memory card containing a program with an IP address is installed in the [product_name]. In this case, after rebooting, the device loads the program from the mSD card and overwrites any IP changes with the address from that stored program.

Thank you, [user_name]. You're correct—the issue was caused by a program on the mSD memory card that had the old IP address. I resolved it by deleting the program, formatting the mSD card, and now the IP change persists.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users faced confusion when trying to permanently update the IP address on a [product_name] controller. The root cause was a program with a previous IP address stored on a microSD card, causing any manual IP changes to be reverted on reboot. Understanding this required technical knowledge, as users generally expect manual IP configuration to persist independently of external memory card contents.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that manually set IP addresses on the [product_name] will remain after rebooting, regardless of any programs stored on plugged-in memory cards.
